name: pulse
title: Pulse — a dial you talk through
description: A full-screen mood dial: drag (or arrow-key) the violet ring to set a value 0–100 and pick a mode chip; the companion reacts. Send to Claude hands the dial over.

pulse.export.summary: "Send to Claude": {label, value, mode}. The engine saves it as a session and closes the window (handoff); answer in the transcript.

pulse.snapshot.summary: Answer to the pulse.snapshot command (re = command id): {value, mode}

pulse.glow.summary: Pulse the ring in a color: {color?, ttl?}

pulse.load.summary: Restore the dial: {value?, mode?}. Animated, idempotent, silent (no value/mode events).

pulse.snapshot.summary: Ask the dial for its state; it replies with a pulse.snapshot event
